title: Pure Timelord
summary: Pure Timelord burn and control build, centering on Level 10 Fairies with 0 ATK that can be Normal Summoned without Tribute while controlling no monsters. Immune to battle and effect destruction and preventing battle damage to their controller, each Timelord delivers a game-warping board reset or massive burn at the end of the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Time Maiden Special Summons itself from the hand while you control no monsters, counts as two Tributes for a Fairy monster, and tributes itself to search a 0-ATK Timelord from your Deck.
Time Maiden can also banish itself from the GY while you control no monsters to Special Summon any 0-ATK Timelord ignoring its summoning conditions directly from the Deck.
Empty Machine discards a Level 10 monster to draw a card, and sends itself to the GY to activate Infinite Machine from your hand or Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Time Maiden + Empty Machine
steps: Special Summon Time Maiden from your hand while controlling no monsters.
Tribute Time Maiden to search Michion, the Timelord (or Sandaion, the Timelord) from your Deck.
Normal Summon Michion, the Timelord without Tributing (legal while you control no monsters).
Activate Empty Machine and set your backrow, ready to initiate Battle Phase pressure or trade cards during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: The Machine Trap Engine
points: Empty Machine discards a Level 10 monster to draw 1 card, prevents your Continuous Traps from being destroyed, and sends itself to face-up activate Infinite Machine.
Infinite Machine allows you to Special Summon a Timelord from your hand once per turn, detaches itself to activate Infinite Light, and sends a Timelord from GY to Deck to draw.

Infinite Light protects all Timelords from targeting, destruction, and being shuffled into the Deck, and once per turn Special Summons up to three Timelords (one each from hand, Deck, and GY) when you control no monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Michion, the Timelord halves the opponent's Life Points at the end of the Battle Phase in which it battled.
Kamion, the Timelord shuffles 1 card the opponent controls back into the Deck without targeting or allowing card responses, then burns for 500 damage.
Zaphion, the Timelord shuffles all Spells and Traps the opponent controls into the Deck, and draws cards until you have 5 when sent from the field to the GY.
Sandaion, the Timelord summons itself with 4000 ATK when only the opponent controls a monster and burns for 2000 damage after battling.
Metaion, Gabrion, Lazion, Raphion, and Hailon offer specialized answers, from bouncing monsters and wiping graveyards to punishing high ATK and resetting LP.
Skypalace Gangaridai and Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Juggernaut Liebe overlay onto two Level 10 Timelords to close games with up to 6000 ATK piercing multiple attacks.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Timelord Progenitor Vorpgate is omitted from the Extra Deck because it requires a Tuner monster, and no Level combination between standard Tuners and Level 10 Timelords cleanly facilitates its Synchro Summon within a pure build.
